# Voice RAG Console

> A production-quality voice-enabled Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system
> supporting 7 Indian languages, built on the AI4Bharat MSMARCO-XI dataset.

## Overview

This system takes voice or text queries in Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi,
Nepali, Odia, and Assamese, and returns grounded answers with source citations.

## Architecture

- **Retrieval**: Hybrid dense (FAISS + multilingual-e5-small) + sparse (BM25)
  with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
- **Chunking**: 4 strategies (Fixed, Sentence, Semantic, Hierarchical)
- **Generation**: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite with JSON-structured output
- **STT**: Sarvam AI (saarika:v1)
- **Guardrails**: Unsafe content, prompt injection, off-topic, grounding verification

## API

- `POST /api/query` — Text query through full RAG pipeline
- `POST /api/voice` — Audio file → STT → RAG pipeline
- `GET /api/health` — Service health check
- `GET /api/metrics` — Latency percentiles (P50/P70/P100)
- `GET /api/config` — Non-sensitive configuration

## Latency

- Retrieval P50: 19ms, P70: 45ms (under 200ms target)
- Full pipeline P50: ~2.2s (includes Gemini LLM generation)
